scope: Curated JSONL only; no mined corpus, source execution, training, retrieval scoring or model selection
normalization: Intents: lowercase and collapse Unicode whitespace. Snippets: trim outer whitespace only; internal Python indentation preserved.
counts: Rows; unique positive question IDs; unique nonempty original intents, rewritten intents and snippets; empty fields; changed rewrites; train/test intersections
groups: Connected components linking equal question ID, normalized original intent or trimmed exact snippet, computed without model outcomes
reporting: Aggregate counts and source hashes only, no source text or per-row IDs
rights: HF card says MIT; Stack Overflow source contribution terms and additional annotations must be distinguished. Audit does not establish redistribution or model publication clearance.
acceptance: Do not call row count a distinct-question count or merge official splits into an official large test set
